title: 5 links that explain today's commodity moves. Chevron is up 50% thisyear — still early, or priced in?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Chevron is up 50% this year, and today it goes head-to-head with  
Johnson & Johnson. U.S. Gold rose about 4% this morning, and the First  
Trust oil and gas ETF has a $45 target, 12% above the price. Plus two  
gold-miner ETFs and two critical-minerals developers, head to head.  
Today's commodity overview is below. Which setup are you watching?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. CVX vs JNJ\*\* — Weighing +50% YTD Momentum Against Defensive  
Stability. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead?  
The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/chevron-cvx-vs-johnson-johnson-jnj-weighing-50-ytd-momentum-against-defensive-stability-39534/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/chevron-cvx-vs-johnson-johnson-jnj-weighing-50-ytd-momentum-against-defensive-stability-39534/)  
  
\*\*2. U.S. Gold (USAU)\*\* — USAU jumped +3.95% to $10.26 from Monday's  
close of $9.87, with the gain built in premarket trading and extended  
into the first hour of the regular session. No verified news or  
fundamental catalyst found.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-u-s-gold-corp-usau-stock-up-3-85-today-39863/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-u-s-gold-corp-usau-stock-up-3-85-today-39863/)

Is Chevron's 50% year-to-date run still early, or already priced in?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,
